name: Grade 8 Integrated Science: The Human Heart
subject: Integrated Science
learningObjectives: By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to draw and label the human heart
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to explain how the heart pumps blood
learningActivities: Discussion: learners locate their pulse and count heartbeats
Diagram work: teacher uses a heart diagram to explain the chambers
Group work: learners draw and label the heart
Explanation: learners describe the flow of blood through the heart
keyPoints: The heart has four chambers: two atria and two ventricles
The heart pumps blood to the lungs and around the body
The heart is made of strong cardiac muscle
commonMisconceptions: Thinking the heart is on the right side of the chest
Confusing the direction of blood flow
lessonEvaluation: Learners draw and label the heart and explain the flow of blood through it.
teacherReflection: Good diagrams produced. Some learners confused arteries and veins - revisit next lesson.
